title: GitHub
load-failed: The GitHub connection could not be loaded: {reason}
unverifiable: The stored GitHub connection could not be verified ({code}). Disconnect it and connect again.
disconnect.title: Disconnect GitHub?
devices.label: Execution device that runs the connection
devices.none: No execution device is online. Try again when one is back.
devices.failed: No execution device could be prepared: {reason}

flow.title: Connect GitHub
read-failed: The state could not be read ({reason}); trying again.
code.expires.announce: The code expires in less than {minutes} min.
disconnect.body.revoked: The stored token is deleted on the hub and on every execution device at once. If the platform signed the access in at GitHub, the device that made the connection revokes it there.
disconnect.body.kept: The stored token is deleted on the hub and on every execution device at once. It did not come from the sign-in through the platform (the operator's account or a transferred access), so it stays valid at GitHub.
disconnected-note.revoked: Disconnected. An access the platform signed in is revoked at GitHub by the device that made the connection.
disconnected-note.kept: Disconnected. This access stays valid at GitHub (the operator's account or a transferred access); revoke it there when it is no longer needed.
